overview: After their high school basketball coach passes away, five good friends and former teammates reunite for a Fourth of July holiday weekend.
plot:
Grown Ups is a 2010 American comedy film directed by Dennis Dugan and written by Adam Sandler, Fred Wolf, and Tim Herlihy. The movie stars Adam Sandler, Kevin James, Chris Rock, David Spade, Rob Schneider, and Salma Hayek.

The story begins with Lenny Feder (Adam Sandler), a wealthy and successful businessman who is married to Roxanne Chase-Feder (Salma Hayek). They have two children, but their marriage has become stale due to the lack of intimacy. Lenny's friends from high school, including Eric Lamonsoff (Kevin James), Kurt McKenzie (Chris Rock), Marcus Higgins (David Spade), and Rob Hilliard (Rob Schneider), are all going through similar midlife crises.

The group decides to take a trip together to Central America for their friend's 40th birthday party. However, things quickly go awry when they discover that the party is actually a funeral for their old high school friend, who died in a tragic accident. The group is forced to confront their past and re-evaluate their lives.

Upon arrival at the funeral, Lenny realizes that he has lost touch with his friends and that they have all become more like family than friends. He decides to take matters into his own hands and organize a backyard barbecue for the group's 40th birthday party, which becomes an opportunity for them to reconnect and reminisce about old times.

As the party progresses, Lenny's marriage is put to the test when Roxanne discovers that he has been having an affair with a younger woman. The group rallies around Lenny, offering their support and advice, but ultimately, it's up to Lenny to make things right with his wife.

Throughout the movie, the characters' relationships are put to the test as they navigate love, friendship, and growing older. In the end, Lenny learns a valuable lesson about the importance of family and friendship, and he makes amends with Roxanne. The movie ends on a heartwarming note, with the group celebrating their 40th birthdays together and looking forward to many more years of friendship.

Overall, Grown Ups is a lighthearted and entertaining comedy that explores themes of friendship, love, and growing older. With its talented ensemble cast and witty dialogue, it's no wonder why this movie became a box office hit.

title: Uncle Boonmee Who Can Recall His Past Lives
original_title: ลุงบุญมีระลึกชาติ
overview: Suffering from acute kidney failure, Boonmee has chosen to spend his final days surrounded by his loved ones in the countryside. Surprisingly, the ghost of his deceased wife appears to care for him, and his long lost son returns home in a non-human form. Contemplating the reasons for his illness, Boonmee treks through the jungle with his family to a mysterious hilltop cave—the birthplace of his first life.
plot:
Uncle Boonmee Who Can Recall His Past Lives (Thai: Lung Bunmi Raluek Chat) is a 2010 Thai fantasy drama written, produced and directed by Apichatpong Weerasethakul. It stars Thanapat Saisaymar as Boonmee, a farmer in his final days, with Jenjira Pongpas as his sister-in-law Jen, Sakda Kaewbuadee as his nephew Tong, Natthakarn Aphaiwong as the ghost of his wife Huay and Jeerasak Kulhong as his lost son Boonsong. The film was the final part of Primitive, a multi-platform art project by the director, and is steeped in ideas of reincarnation and memory.

Boonmee, who is dying of kidney failure, lives on his farm in northeastern Thailand with Jen and Tong, cared for by his Laotian assistant Jaai, who gives him dialysis. One evening at dinner, Huay, who died more than a decade earlier, quietly materializes at the table, having heard the prayers said for her. Soon a hairy figure with glowing red eyes joins them: Boonsong, who vanished years earlier after becoming obsessed with a creature he had photographed, a monkey ghost, and who has since mated with one and taken on its form.

The family accepts these visitors with calm and curiosity. Boonmee wonders whether his illness is the result of karma, a consequence of killing communists while serving in the army and of killing insects on his farm. Interwoven with these scenes is a mysterious episode about a princess who, seeing a more beautiful version of herself reflected in a forest pool, gives herself to a talking catfish. As death approaches, Huay leads Boonmee, Jen and Tong through the jungle at night to a cave, where Boonmee senses he was born in a past life he cannot remember, and he recounts a dream of a future in which people from the past are made to disappear.

Unfolding at a slow, meditative pace, the film blends folklore, Buddhist belief, political memory and the history of cinema itself, and was partly inspired by a 1983 book by the Buddhist abbot Phra Sripariyattiweti about a man who could recall his past lives.

Uncle Boonmee premiered at the 2010 Cannes Film Festival, where it won the Palme d'Or, the first Thai film to do so. It was released in the United States by Strand Releasing in March 2011. It received near-universal acclaim, with 90 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and a Metacritic score of 87, and is regarded by many critics as one of the greatest films ever made.

title: Life As We Know It
tagline: A comedy about taking it one step at a time.
overview: After a distastrous first date for caterer Holly and network sports director Messer, all they have is common is a dislike for each other and their love for their goddaughter Sophie. But when they suddenly become all Sophie has in this world, Holly and Messer must set their differences aside. Juggling careers and social calendars, they'll have to find common ground while living under the same roof.
plot:
Holly Berenson is the owner of a small Atlanta bakery, and Eric Messer is a promising television technical sports director for the Atlanta Hawks. Their best friends, Peter and Alison, set them up on a blind date that goes horribly wrong and results in both hating each other with a passion.
As the years go by, Peter and Alison get married and have a baby girl named Sophie. They also select Holly and Eric – who teasingly tolerate each other – as the godparents.
Shortly after Sophie's first birthday, Peter and Alison are killed in a car crash. Holly and Eric learn that their friends named them Sophie's joint guardians. After discovering that none of Peter and Alison's relatives are fit to take care of Sophie, the two put their differences aside and move into Sophie's home.
Living together proves to be a struggle. One evening, Holly is away at an important catering job when Eric is given the opportunity to direct a big basketball game. He takes Sophie with him, but her crying distracts him, leading to him making a big mistake on the broadcast. When they get home, Eric and Holly argue, but later they make up.
Holly goes on a date with Sam, Sophie's pediatrician. The date is cut short when Eric calls to tell Sam that Sophie has a high fever. When they join him at the hospital, Eric sees Holly kiss Sam.
Over time, the guardians discover that raising a child is more expensive than they had expected, so Holly can no longer afford to expand her business. Eric helps by investing in her company. They cement the new relationship by going on a date, which ends with them having sex and developing strong feelings.
Their Child Protective Services caseworker Janine tells them they must make a firm commitment, either to stay together, or break up, as waffling in between would be bad for Sophie. Eric is offered his dream job with the Phoenix Suns, and does not discuss it with Holly. When she finds out, she tells him to take the job, accusing him of looking for a way out of raising Sophie.
At Thanksgiving break, Eric returns from Phoenix for a visit, hoping to patch things up with Holly. She invites him to a dinner that she and Sam are hosting for neighbors and friends. Eric and Holly argue loudly when he learns she is planning to sell the house soon, as the upkeep is too costly. She accuses him of deserting her and Sophie, while he points out how quickly she replaced him.
Eric tells Holly he loves her, but leaves the dinner, planning to return to Phoenix. Once alone with Holly, Sam says that if he and his former wife had fought the way that Eric and she did, they would still be together. He tells Holly to work out her feelings for Eric, and leaves. That night, Sophie calls Holly "Mama" for the first time.
Janine visits to make her final determination whether Holly and Eric are fit parents. Holly realizes that she cannot take care of Sophie without Eric, and that she loves him.

title: Ondine
tagline: The truth is not what you know. It's what you believe.
overview: An Irish fisherman discovers a woman in his fishing net believing her to be a mermaid.
plot:
Syracuse, uncomfortably called "Circus" by some, is trawling on his boat and finds a scantily clad young woman caught in his net. He sees she is alive and resuscitates her. She calls herself Ondine and refuses to be taken to the hospital, not wanting to be seen by anyone else. He shelters her in a caravan house that belonged to his late mother in a quiet harbor, which makes him late for picking up his daughter Annie who uses a wheelchair and lives with his ex-wife Maura. During Annie's dialysis, he tells her a story about a fisherman that catches a woman out of the sea. Annie explains the woman could be a magical selkie.
Annie receives a new powerchair from the CRC, and upon returning home is greeted by Maura's boyfriend Alex. Maura flips off Syracuse for missing the doctor who had news on a kidney match for Annie.
Next morning, Syracuse finds Ondine washing clothes in a stream, singing in an unknown language. She follows him on his boat to work that day. He pulls up only empty lobster pots until Ondine starts singing, after which every pot contains a catch. Still not wanting to be seen, Ondine refuses to follow Syracuse to the fish market where the lobsters are sold. He buys a dress and lies to the store clerk that it's for Annie when she grows up.
When Syracuse picks up Annie from her school, he continues the fisherman story by explaining how the woman sings to the fish for him to catch, a song in a language he has never heard before. Annie states that Selk is the language of the selkie. Syracuse stammers that his lobsters hear her sing, which makes Annie curious as to whose story this is, and she secretly follows him to the caravan. When Syracuse asks how long she will stay, Ondine says it is up to him. He happily replies forever and happily ever after, like the fairytale he has been building with Annie, who watches them without being noticed.
Annie is seen back home studying all her new library books on seals and selkies. Alex says selkies are Scottish creatures, but the one Annie saw is not.
Syracuse regularly torments the local priest in confession because there aren't any AA meetings in town. He recalls a recurring nightmare where he is at Alex's funeral and reunited with Maura, still with her drinking problem. As the priest pushes the subject away, Syracuse reveals he pulled a woman out of the water with his net and kept her, reminding the priest he can't tell anyone.
Ondine is shown alone, tidying up the caravan, then tries her new clothing as if the experience was a first, especially when she stretches leggings over one splayed hand so it looks webbed.
The next day, Annie sees Ondine swimming and approaches her on the dock. They bond as Annie tells her about selkies and ostensibly Ondine herself, which Ondine goes along with, kissing Annie goodbye before the child goes back to her mother. Syracuse goes in the library asking for books about selkies, but discovers that Annie took them all.

title: The Disappearance of Alice Creed
tagline: Where is Alice Creed?
overview: A rich man's daughter is held captive in an abandoned apartment by two former convicts who abducted her and hold her ransom in exchange for her father's money.
plot:
Criminals Vic and Danny kidnap a woman named Alice Creed, the only child of a wealthy family. In a secured room, they forcibly strip her of all her clothes, handcuff her to a bed, and gag her – all while wearing jumpsuits and ski masks themselves. After taking pictures of her they put a tracksuit on her and a hood over her head. The men leave to dispose of all three's clothes and send the pictures to Alice's father for ransom. The men refuse to let her out of her shackles, even to go to the toilet, seemingly just to embarrass her. Neither shows emotion while humiliating Alice, but Vic mocks Danny for being less calm.
Vic leaves to make preparations, whilst Danny guards Alice. Alice persuades Danny to uncuff her, then grabs his pistol and fires a warning shot. To keep from being shot, Danny removes his ski mask and reveals he is her former lover. He says he met Vic while in prison and chose her as their victim. Danny plans to double-cross Vic and offers to start a new life with Alice and the money. As Vic returns, Alice agrees to go along with Danny's plan and be tied back up. Danny tries and fails to dispose of the spent bullet casing in the toilet, ultimately forcing himself to swallow it when Vic beats down the door. The two then discuss their plans to run away together after collecting the ransom and share a passionate kiss, revealing they were lovers in prison.
Later, when Vic is away again, Alice seduces Danny and handcuffs him to the bed, but finds the door bolted shut when she tries to escape. She finds a mobile phone and dials 999 but is unable to tell the operator where she is. She threatens Danny with his gun for the front door keys. Danny tells her they are in his pocket and knocks her out when she tries to retrieve them. Vic returns and says the exchange is on. Danny leaves the two and goes to the van.
Vic finds the mobile phone and sees the 999 call as well as the bullet hole in the wall. He ungags and threatens her. She screams for Danny, then tells Vic that Danny intends to double-cross him. Vic is shocked by the betrayal. When Danny returns, Vic says he feels something is 'not right', but Danny does not reveal anything. They inject Alice with a sedative and take her to a deserted, rural warehouse where they chain her in a back room. Vic asks Danny for his keys to the locks and drives him to the woods to pick up the ransom. There, Vic confronts Danny and threatens to kill both him and Alice. He says the hole they dug for the ransom is now for Danny. Danny flees, and Vic shoots him. Although wounded, Danny manages to hide. Vic retrieves the ransom elsewhere and returns for Alice. As he tries to inject her again, Danny appears and grabs his gun. During the standoff, Alice learns of Vic and Danny's true relationship.
Danny shoots Vic point blank and, to Alice's horror, leaves her in the dark and handcuffed to the railing next to the dying man. However, Vic revives long enough to throw the keys to her.

title: The Karate Kid
tagline: A Challenge He Never Imagined. A Teacher He Never Expected.
overview: Twelve-year-old Dre Parker could have been the most popular kid in Detroit, but his mother's latest career move has landed him in China. Dre immediately falls for his classmate Mei Ying but the cultural differences make such a friendship impossible. Even worse, Dre's feelings make him an enemy of the class bully, Cheng. With no friends in a strange land, Dre has nowhere to turn but maintenance man Mr. Han, who is a kung fu master. As Han teaches Dre that kung fu is not about punches and parries, but maturity and calm, Dre realizes that facing down the bullies will be the fight of his life.
plot:
The Karate Kid is a 2010 martial arts drama directed by Harald Zwart from a screenplay by Christopher Murphey, based on a story by Robert Mark Kamen. A remake of the 1984 film, it moves the story to China and replaces karate with kung fu. Jaden Smith stars as a young American boy, with Jackie Chan as his teacher, Taraji P. Henson as his mother, and Wenwen Han, Zhenwei Wang and Yu Rongguang in supporting roles. It was filmed in Beijing.

Twelve-year-old Dre Parker moves from Detroit to Beijing with his widowed mother, Sherry, who has been transferred by her employer. He quickly develops a crush on Meiying, a young violinist, but this draws the hostility of Cheng, a kung fu student who repeatedly bullies and beats him. After Dre takes revenge with a bucket of dirty water, Cheng and his gang chase him down and attack him, until the apartment building's quiet maintenance man, Mr. Han, intervenes and effortlessly fends them off, revealing himself as a kung fu master.

Han explains that the boys have been taught to be merciless by their teacher, Master Li. When Han and Dre visit Li's studio to make peace, Li demands a fight, and Han instead agrees that Dre will compete against Li's students in an upcoming open tournament, on condition that they leave him alone until then. Han's training begins unconventionally, with Dre spending days repeatedly taking off, hanging up and putting on his jacket, which turns out to build the muscle memory for kung fu techniques. Han teaches him that kung fu is about serenity and maturity rather than violence, and takes him to a mountain temple where he witnesses a woman mirroring a cobra. Dre learns that Han lost his wife and young son in a car accident he blames himself for, and helps his teacher face his grief, while also winning back the approval of Meiying's father after their friendship briefly gets her into trouble.

At the tournament, Dre advances through the rounds, until a student of Li's is ordered to injure his leg in the semifinal and is disqualified. Insisting on competing, Dre has Han treat his leg with traditional cupping, and in the final against Cheng, he uses the cobra stance he saw at the temple to win with a kick to the head. Cheng presents him with the trophy, and Li's students bow to Han in respect.

Released by Columbia Pictures on June 11, 2010, the film received generally positive reviews and grossed about $359 million worldwide.

title: Jane Eyre
tagline: She sought refuge… and found a place haunted by secrets.
overview: After a bleak childhood, Jane Eyre goes out into the world to become a governess. As she lives happily in her new position at Thornfield Hall, she meet the dark, cold, and abrupt master of the house, Mr. Rochester. Jane and her employer grow close in friendship and she soon finds herself falling in love with him. Happiness seems to have found Jane at last, but could Mr. Rochester's terrible secret be about to destroy it forever?
plot:
Jane Eyre is a 2011 romantic gothic drama directed by Cary Joji Fukunaga and written by Moira Buffini, based on Charlotte Brontë's 1847 novel. It stars Mia Wasikowska as Jane Eyre and Michael Fassbender as Edward Rochester, with Jamie Bell as St. John Rivers, Judi Dench as the housekeeper Mrs. Fairfax, Sally Hawkins as Jane's cruel aunt Mrs. Reed, Simon McBurney, Imogen Poots, Holliday Grainger and Tamzin Merchant.

The film opens with Jane fleeing Thornfield Hall in tears and collapsing on the moors, where she is taken in by the clergyman St. John Rivers and his sisters. Through flashbacks, it recounts her harsh childhood as an orphan mistreated by her aunt and cousin, and her years at the austere Lowood School, where she loses her friend Helen Burns to consumption. At eighteen, Jane becomes governess to Adèle, the young French ward of Edward Rochester, the brooding master of Thornfield Hall.

Jane and Rochester are drawn to each other through their frank, spirited conversations, while mysterious events disturb the house, including a fire in Rochester's bedroom and a violent attack on a visitor from Jamaica, Richard Mason. Although Rochester appears to be courting the elegant Blanche Ingram, he eventually declares his love for Jane and proposes. Their wedding is interrupted by the revelation that Rochester is already married to Bertha, Mason's sister, whose madness has led him to lock her away in the house. Heartbroken, Jane leaves Thornfield, and while living with the Rivers family she must choose between a loveless offer of marriage and missionary work and her enduring feelings for Rochester.

Fukunaga's version emphasizes the gothic atmosphere and psychological intensity of the novel, using a non-linear structure built around Jane's flight from Thornfield.

Jane Eyre opened in a limited release in the United States on 11 March 2011, achieving the best specialty debut of the year, and was released in Britain in September. It received positive reviews, with 85 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus praised Wasikowska's portrayal, and a Metacritic score of 76. Michael O'Connor's costume design was nominated for an Academy Award.

title: Bad Boys for Life
tagline: Ride together. Die together.
overview: Marcus and Mike are forced to confront new threats, career changes, and midlife crises as they join the newly created elite team AMMO of the Miami police department to take down the ruthless Armando Armas, the vicious leader of a Miami drug cartel.
plot:
Bad Boys for Life is a 2020 American action comedy film directed by Adil El Arbi and Bilall Fallah, and written by Peter Craig. The movie stars Will Smith, Martin Lawrence, Vanessa Hudgens, Alexander Ludwig, and Nick Nolte.

The film takes place nine years after the events of Bad Boys II (2003). Mike Lowrey (Will Smith) is now a retired Miami cop who has moved to Los Angeles with his wife, Syd (Vanessa Hudgens), and their son. Meanwhile, Marcus Burnett (Martin Lawrence) is still working as a Miami cop.

The story begins with the return of the villainous Armando Diaz's (Joel Rodriguez) nephew, Javier (Alexander Ludwig), who seeks revenge against Mike and Marcus for killing his uncle in the previous film. Javier kidnaps Syd, forcing Mike to come out of retirement and team up with Marcus once again to rescue her.

As they delve deeper into the case, they discover that Javier is working for a powerful cartel leader named Elena (Vanessa's character has been replaced by a new one, played by Vanessa Hudgens), who seeks revenge against the United States for killing her family. The two former partners must put aside their differences and work together to take down Elena and her team.

Throughout the film, Mike and Marcus face various challenges as they navigate their way through the cartel's operations. They also have to deal with the fact that they are no longer as young or as skilled as they used to be, which makes it harder for them to keep up with the younger and more agile cartel members.

As the story unfolds, Mike and Marcus discover that Elena is using a new technology to control people's minds, making her an almost unstoppable force. The two former partners come up with a plan to infiltrate Elena's operation and take her down from the inside.

The film features plenty of action-packed sequences, including car chases, shootouts, and hand-to-hand combat. Will Smith and Martin Lawrence reprise their roles as Mike and Marcus, delivering their signature humor and chemistry that fans have come to expect from the franchise.

In the end, Mike and Marcus successfully take down Elena and her team, saving Syd and restoring order to Miami. The film concludes with a heartwarming moment between Mike and his son, as well as a nod to the original Bad Boys duo's partnership.

Overall, Bad Boys for Life is an entertaining action-comedy that delivers on its promise of high-octane action and witty banter. While it may not be as groundbreaking as some of the other films in the franchise, it provides a fun and satisfying conclusion to the series.

title: Gulliver's Travels
tagline: Something big is going down.
overview: Travel writer Lemuel Gulliver takes an assignment in Bermuda, but ends up on the island of Liliput, where he towers over its tiny citizens.
plot:
Gulliver's Travels is a 2010 American fantasy adventure comedy directed by Rob Letterman, in his live-action debut, and written by Joe Stillman and Nicholas Stoller. Loosely based on the first part of Jonathan Swift's 1726 novel but set in the present day, it stars Jack Black as Lemuel Gulliver, with Jason Segel, Emily Blunt, Amanda Peet, Billy Connolly, Chris O'Dowd, T.J. Miller, James Corden and Catherine Tate. 20th Century Fox released it in the United States on December 25, 2010.

Gulliver works in the mail room of a New York newspaper and secretly adores the travel editor, Darcy Silverman. Trying to impress her, he submits a travel piece cobbled together from plagiarised material, and Darcy rewards him with an assignment to investigate the Bermuda Triangle. Sailing into the Triangle, he falls asleep at the helm, is caught by a storm and a waterspout, and washes up on Lilliput, an island of tiny people whose society resembles old Europe.

Treated as a monster, he is imprisoned in a cave, where he meets Horatio, a commoner jailed by General Edward for loving Princess Mary, whom Edward wants for himself. Gulliver rescues Mary from raiders of the rival island Blefuscia and puts out a fire threatening King Theodore, and is hailed as a hero. Claiming to be the President of Manhattan, he lives in luxury and stages Lilliputian versions of films and his own boasts, while advising Horatio on wooing Mary. The humiliated Edward sabotages the island's defences, and when Gulliver single-handedly defeats the Blefuscian fleet, Edward defects.

Using plans from a video game manual Gulliver lost, Edward pilots a giant robot that leads a Blefuscian invasion, forces Gulliver to confess he is just a mail-room worker, and banishes him to Brobdingnag, where a giant girl keeps him as a doll. Horatio finds him and reveals that Darcy, who followed him into the Triangle, is being held by the Blefuscians. Gulliver escapes, defeats Edward in a duel with Horatio's help, and ends the war by persuading both sides to make peace, before returning home with Darcy as a genuine travel writer.

Critics were dismissive, with a 19% Rotten Tomatoes approval. Made for about $112 million, the film flopped in North America but grossed $237 million worldwide.

title: Passion Play
tagline: Love Is Stronger Than Death.
overview: An angel under the thumb of a ruthless gangster is saved by a trumpet player down on his luck.
plot:
Passion Play is a 2011 American fantasy drama film written and directed by Mitch Glazer, in his feature directorial debut, and executive produced by Rebecca Wang. Mickey Rourke stars as a down-and-out jazz trumpeter, with Megan Fox as a carnival performer born with wings, Bill Murray as a gangster, and Rhys Ifans, Kelly Lynch and Robert Wisdom in supporting roles. Filmed from December 2009, it premiered at the 2010 Toronto International Film Festival, where its poor reception led to talk of a direct-to-video release.

Nate Poole is a washed-up jazz musician and recovering heroin addict whose luck has run out. After a gig one night he is attacked, tied up and driven into the desert by a hitman. Just as he is about to be executed, his would-be killer is shot dead by a group of Native Americans, who leave Nate unharmed. Wandering through the desert, he reaches a travelling carnival and freak show, full of fire eaters and sword swallowers, and asks to use a telephone.

There he becomes fascinated by Lily Luster, a beautiful young woman with real wings who is exhibited as one of the sideshow's attractions. Lily is aloof at first, but begins to see the kindly Nate as a possible escape from her life. When the carnival owner, Sam Adamo, tries to kill Nate, Lily saves him by stealing a truck, and the two run away to the city, where they begin a tentative romance.

Fearing for his life, Nate goes to see Happy Shannon, the wealthy gangster who ordered his death after Nate slept with Happy's wife, whom Happy also had killed. Nate offers him most of the profits from putting Lily on display, but Happy only believes in her wings after seeing her from a distance. He then takes Lily for himself, promising to leave Nate alive as long as she stays with him. Nate realises that he loves her and tries in vain to free her. Adamo, discovering where Lily is, breaks in to take her back and is shot dead by Happy.

When Nate learns that Happy is showing Lily in a glass case at a theatre, he smashes the case and the two flee to the roof, pursued by Happy's men. Lily doubts she can fly, so Nate leaps from the building and she jumps after him, catching him in mid-air. As they fly over the desert, Nate glimpses his own body lying where the hitman had taken him, suggesting that everything since had been his dying dream.

The film was savaged by critics, holding a 3% approval rating on Rotten Tomatoes.

title: Tangled
tagline: They're taking adventure to new lengths.
overview: When the kingdom's most wanted-and most charming-bandit Flynn Rider hides out in a mysterious tower, he's taken hostage by Rapunzel, a beautiful and feisty tower-bound teen with 70 feet of magical, golden hair. Flynn's curious captor, who's looking for her ticket out of the tower where she's been locked away for years, strikes a deal with the handsome thief and the unlikely duo sets off on an action-packed escapade, complete with a super-cop horse, an over-protective chameleon and a gruff gang of pub thugs.
plot:
Tangled is a 2010 animated musical fantasy film produced by Walt Disney Animation Studios. The movie is a modern retelling of the classic fairy tale Rapunzel, with a few twists and creative liberties.

The story follows Princess Rapunzel (voiced by Mandy Moore), a young woman with long, magical hair that has healing properties. She lives in a tower in the kingdom of Corona, guarded by Mother Gothel (voiced by Donna Murphy), who claims to be Rapunzel's mother. However, it is revealed that Gothel has been using Rapunzel's hair to stay young and beautiful.

One day, thief Flynn Rider (voiced by Zachary Levi) stumbles upon the tower while on the run from the law. He convinces Rapunzel to join him on a journey to see the floating lights in the sky, which she believes are her only connection to the outside world. As they travel together, they develop feelings for each other and become embroiled in a plot by Gothel to use Rapunzel's hair to gain control over the kingdom.

Throughout their adventure, Rapunzel discovers her true identity and the secrets of her past. She also learns about her royal heritage and the prophecy that foretells her destiny as the queen of Corona. Meanwhile, Flynn must confront his own troubled past and learn to trust himself and others.

The movie features a range of memorable characters, including Maximus (voiced by Donal Logue), a loyal and lovable horse who becomes Rapunzel's companion, and Pascal (voiced by Jeffrey Tambor), a chatty and endearing pet chameleon. The film's soundtrack, featuring songs like "When Will My Life Begin" and "I've Got a Dream," is also noteworthy for its catchy melodies and heartfelt lyrics.

Overall, Tangled offers a fresh take on the classic Rapunzel story, with engaging characters, witty humor, and stunning animation. The movie's themes of self-discovery, friendship, and embracing one's true identity make it a delightful and entertaining watch for audiences of all ages.

title: Rampage
tagline: Vengeance is ruthless.
overview: The boredom of small town life is eating Bill Williamson alive. Feeling constrained and claustrophobic in the meaningless drudgery of everyday life and helpless against overwhelming global dissolution, Bill begins a descent into madness. His shockingly violent plan will shake the very foundations of society by painting the streets red with blood.
plot:
Rampage is a 2009 action thriller written and directed by Uwe Boll, starring Brendan Fletcher as Bill Williamson, Shaun Sipos as his friend Evan Drince, Michael Paré as Sheriff Melvoy, and Lynda Boyd and Matt Frewer as Bill's parents. It received a theatrical release in Germany and went direct to video elsewhere. Notably, it was the first of Boll's films to earn mainly positive reviews, and it spawned two sequels, Rampage: Capital Punishment (2014) and Rampage: President Down (2016).

Bill Williamson is a 23-year-old mechanic living with his parents in the fictional small town of Tenderville, Oregon. He feels overwhelmed by the world's problems, by constant television and radio news and by the political rants of Evan, apparently his only friend. His parents tell him it is time to move out, a coffee shop owner annoys him, and his boss condescendingly refuses him a raise.

At home, Bill quietly prints counterfeit money and builds a suit of steel body armor with a ballistic helmet and a mask. Heavily armed, he drives into town, first disabling the police by blowing up their headquarters with a remote-controlled van bomb. He then walks through the streets shooting people at random, his armor deflecting the bullets of the officers who try to stop him. Moving from a salon to a bingo hall to a bank, he kills almost indiscriminately, robbing the bank and then burning what appears to be the stolen money while declaring that money is worthless. His rampage leads to a forest where Evan is waiting for a paintball match and where the sheriff pursues him, and as the death toll mounts it becomes clear that Bill's killing spree is part of a calculated plan rather than a sudden outburst.

The film presents a bleak, provocative critique of a society saturated by media and money, with a protagonist who believes the world's population must be reduced, and it is shot in a raw visual style.

Rampage surprised many reviewers. /Film said Boll had finally made a good, if not great, film, and Bloody Disgusting praised his evolution as a director, while Variety's Peter Debruge called it uncompromising and nearly unwatchable, criticizing both its subject and its visual style.

title: Dogtooth
tagline: The cat is the most feared animal there is!
overview: Three teenagers are confined to an isolated country estate that could very well be on another planet. The trio spend their days listening to endless homemade tapes that teach them a whole new vocabulary. Any word that comes from beyond their family abode is instantly assigned a new meaning. Hence 'the sea' refers to a large armchair and 'zombies' are little yellow flowers. Having invented a brother whom they claim to have ostracized for his disobedience, the uber-controlling parents terrorize their offspring into submission.
plot:
A couple and their adult son and two adult daughters live in a fenced compound. The children have no knowledge of the outside world; their parents say they will be ready to leave once they lose a dogtooth, and that one can safely leave only by car. The children entertain themselves with endurance games, such as holding their hands under hot water. They believe they have a brother on the other side of the fence to whom they throw supplies. The parents reward good behavior with stickers and bad with violence.
The father pays an employee of his factory, Christina, to come to the house and have sex with the son. Frustrated by the son's refusal to give her cunnilingus, Christina trades her headband with the elder daughter in exchange for cunnilingus from her. The elder daughter convinces the younger daughter to lick her shoulder by bartering the headband. Later, the younger daughter volunteers to lick the elder again. The elder has nothing to offer in exchange, but the younger does not mind and experiments by licking other body parts.
The father visits a dog training facility and demands to have his dog returned. The trainer refuses because the dog has not finished its training, and asks: "Do we want an animal or a friend?" When the children are terrified by a stray cat in the garden, the son kills it with a pair of pruning shears. Deciding to take advantage of the incident, the father shreds his clothes, covers himself in fake blood, and tells his children that their unseen brother was killed by a cat, the most dangerous creature. After he teaches them to bark on all fours to fend off cats, the family holds a memorial service for the brother.
Christina again barters for oral sex from the elder daughter. The daughter rejects her offer of hair gel and demands the Hollywood VHS tapes in her bag. She watches the films (Rocky IV and Jaws) in secret and afterwards recreates scenes and quotes their dialogue. When the father discovers the tapes, he beats her with one of them, then goes to Christina's flat and hits her with her VCR, cursing her future children to be corrupted by "bad influences".
The parents decide that, with Christina no longer available, they will have the son choose one of his sisters as a new sexual partner. After fondling both sisters with his eyes closed, he chooses the elder. She is uncomfortable during their sex and afterwards threatens her brother in the style of Hollywood film dialogues.
During a performance for the parents' wedding anniversary, the younger daughter stops to rest, but the elder continues and dances the choreography from Flashdance, disturbing her parents. That night, she knocks out one of her dogteeth with a dumbbell and hides in the boot of her father's car. The father discovers her tooth fragments and searches for her fruitlessly. He drives to work the next day; the car sits outside the factory, unattended.

title: Middle Men
tagline: Business is a lot like sex ... getting in is easy, pulling out is hard.
overview: Chronicles Jack Harris, one of the pioneers of internet commerce, as he wrestles with his morals and struggles not to drown in a sea of conmen, mobsters, drug addicts, and pornstars.
plot:
Middle Men is a 2009 American black comedy-drama film directed by George Gallo and written by Gallo and Andy Weiss, inspired by the experiences of Christopher Mallick, founder of ePassporte, who was accused of taking millions from its customers to finance the film. Luke Wilson stars as Jack Harris, with Giovanni Ribisi as Wayne Beering, Gabriel Macht as Buck Dolby, James Caan as the lawyer Jerry Haggerty, Jacinda Barrett as Jack's wife Diana, Laura Ramsey as Audrey Dawns and Rade Šerbedžija as Nikita Sokoloff.

In 2004 Jack leaves his Houston home with millions of dollars to pay off Russian gangsters. In 1997 Los Angeles, Jack is running a nightclub for an ailing friend, while nearby two drug-addled friends, Wayne and Buck, a former NASA scientist, wonder why the internet has no pornography. Buck quickly writes a program that lets visitors pay by credit card to view explicit pictures, and the money pours in. They give Sokoloff, a Russian mobster with a strip club, a quarter of the business for access to his dancers, then fail to pay him. Haggerty, the crooked lawyer they hire, brings in Jack, who becomes a partner and buys Haggerty out for $200,000. When Sokoloff's nephew comes to collect $400,000 and threatens Jack's family, one of Jack's bodyguards kills him with a single punch; the partners dump the body at sea, and Sokoloff, doubting their cover story, demands a half share. Jack abandons the website to concentrate on billing, and their company, 24/7 Billing, becomes a hugely profitable middleman for other adult sites. Seduced by money, he neglects his family and begins an affair with Audrey, a porn star whose live stream, it emerges, is used by the government to track terrorists. The resentful Haggerty manipulates Wayne and Buck into processing payments for child pornography sites run by Denny Z, and when the pair confide in him about the nephew's death, he turns Sokoloff against Jack. Sokoloff's men kidnap the son of Jack's maid, believing him to be Jack's own son. Jack signs his share over in exchange for the boy but backdates the contract to before the child pornography business began; Sokoloff kills Haggerty and lets Jack go. Wayne and Buck later testify against Denny Z, Sokoloff flees, reportedly to Moscow, and Jack's wife takes him back.

Released in the United States on 6 August 2010, Middle Men grossed only $754,301 against a $20 million budget. Reviews were mixed, with a 39% Rotten Tomatoes rating and a Metacritic score of 60.

title: Ramona and Beezus
tagline: A Little Sister Goes A Long Way.
overview: Ramona is a little girl with a very big imagination and a nose for mischief. Her playful antics keep everyone in her loving family on their toes, including her older sister Beezus, who's just trying to survive her first year of high school. Through all the ups and downs of childhood, Ramona and Beezus learn that anything's possible when you believe in yourself and rely on each other.
plot:
Adventurous and creative third-grader Ramona Quimby often finds herself in trouble at school and at home, and usually spends time with her neighbor and best friend, Howard Kemp. When her father Robert loses his job and the family falls into severe debt, Ramona's efforts to earn money end up backfiring in humorous ways. She repeatedly embarrasses her older sister, Beatrice, in front of Henry Huggins the paperboy (who is also Beatrice's crush) by calling her the family nickname, "Beezus".
Although he had worked as an executive in a company since Beezus's birth, Robert quarrels with Dorothy (his wife and the girls' mother) when he considers pursuing a new, more creative career. Meanwhile, Ramona's visiting aunt Beatrice, her sister's namesake, is one of the few who accepts her despite all her eccentricities. After a car-painting accident involving Bea's old flame Hobart, who happens to be Howard's uncle, Ramona gives up her money-making schemes.
The next day, Ramona ruins her school portrait by cracking a raw egg in her hair and making a face when the photographer asks her to say "Peas" instead of "Cheese". Ramona's worries increase the following day, when her classmate Susan reveals that after her own father lost his job, her parents divorced and her father moved to Tacoma. The news makes Ramona physically sick, and Robert has to pick her up early from school, interfering with a sudden job interview. Instead of being angry, Robert decides to spend the rest of his day drawing a mural with Ramona. While Ramona and Beezus attempt to make dinner for their parents, the pan catches fire while Beezus is on the phone with Henry. During the ensuing argument, Henry overhears that Beezus loves him. Still upset, Ramona goes to feed her cat Picky-Picky but is devastated to find him dead. The girls' private funeral for their cat helps them reconcile. A job offer for Robert in Oregon leads Ramona's parents to decide to sell their house.
As the family touches up the garden during an open house, Ramona inadvertently initiates a water fight with the neighbors, which floods the neighbors' backyard and exposes a box that Hobart buried there years ago. The box contains mementos of Bea and Hobart's teenage romance, and in light of their rekindling relationship, he proposes to her. Hesitantly, Bea accepts, and the family begins planning the impromptu wedding.
Furious that her aunt broke her promise not to get "reeled in" with Hobart again, Ramona rushes home, seeking solace in the attic. The fragile floorboards break, leaving her legs dangling from the ceiling during the open house. After they clear out, Robert scolds her for her lack of maturity. Feeling unwanted, Ramona decides to run away. Unable to convince her not to leave, Dorothy helps her pack. Opening the heavy suitcase at a bus stop, Ramona discovers that Dorothy intentionally made it heavy to keep her from getting far. Inside, Dorothy packed a book of Robert's sketches of Ramona.

title: Cyrus
tagline: John met the woman of his dreams. Then he met her son...
overview: With John's social life at a standstill and his ex-wife about to get remarried, a down on his luck divorcée finally meets the woman of his dreams, only to discover she has another man in her life - her son. Before long, the two are locked in a battle of wits for the woman they both love-and it appears only one man can be left standing when it's over.
plot:
Jamie informs her ex-husband John that she is getting married. Even though they have been apart for seven years, the news devastates John, who was already depressed. At a party the next night, John gets more and more drunk until he ends up urinating in the bushes, where Molly strikes up a conversation. Molly goes back to John's house but leaves during the night, after they have had sex. Molly returns for dinner the next night, and again leaves after they have had sex. John follows her to her house and falls asleep in his car. The next morning, he approaches the house and meets Molly's 21-year-old son Cyrus. Cyrus invites John inside and makes friendly conversation with him. Molly is startled to see John in her house when she returns, but the trio have dinner together. John is unnerved by the unnatural intimacy between Molly and Cyrus.
The next morning, John cannot find his shoes, which he had left in the living room. Through the day, he gets increasingly disturbed by their disappearance and starts to worry that Cyrus is messing with him. He ropes Jamie into meeting Molly and Cyrus, in order to appraise his paranoia. Jamie finds Cyrus sweet, if a little overly intimate with his mother. Relieved, John returns for another night at Molly's home. As they begin to have sex for the first time in her house, Cyrus screams in his room, and Molly runs to comfort him. She does not return to John, who goes out looking for her in the middle of the night. He encounters Cyrus holding a large kitchen knife, allegedly making a snack. Cyrus says he had a night terror, and that Molly has gone to sleep. He then advises John to back off on the relationship because he is scaring off Molly. John leaves a note for her and goes home. In the morning, Cyrus sits Molly down and tells her that John had confessed to him that she was coming on too strong. When she presses Cyrus for details, he explodes in a tantrum and storms off, checking through the window to make sure that she is upset. When Cyrus finally comes home, he explains that he has rented a room and will be moving out. After a few happy days alone together, John decides to move in with Molly.
One night, as they begin to have sex, Cyrus surprises them and says that he has been having panic attacks and wants to return home. John confronts Cyrus privately, and Cyrus admits that he has been deliberately sabotaging their relationship. He moves back home, and John remains wary of him. The night before Jamie's wedding, he warns Cyrus not to cause trouble. At the wedding, however, Cyrus is hurt when he sees how the event stirs romantic feelings between John and his mother. Drunk, he confronts John in the bathroom and attacks him, yelling that John will not take his mother away from him. As John defends himself, they spill out of the bathroom, into open view. Cyrus makes it look like John attacked him. John advises Molly to open her eyes, and storms off, furious.

title: Dragon Ball Z: The Tree of Might
original_title: ドラゴンボールZ 地球まるごと超決戦
tagline: From the seeds of destruction, a new threat has arisen.
overview: Goku and friends must stop a band of space pirates from consuming fruit from the Tree of Might before it's destructive powers drain Earth's energy.
plot:
Dragon Ball Z: The Tree of Might is a 1990 Japanese animated science fantasy martial arts film produced by Toei Animation, based on the popular manga and anime series Dragon Ball Z. The movie takes place during the Saiyan Saga of the original Dragon Ball Z series.

The story begins with Goku and his friends celebrating the defeat of Frieza on Planet Namek. However, their celebration is short-lived as a powerful being known as Turles arrives on Earth. Unbeknownst to Goku and his friends, Turles is actually the long-lost brother of Raditz, the Saiyan who killed Goku's father.

Turles reveals that he has come to Earth to destroy it and its inhabitants, and to claim the Tree of Might, a powerful being with the ability to grant wishes. The Tree of Might is located on Earth and is guarded by a group of powerful warriors known as the Guardians of the Tree.

Goku and his friends soon discover Turles' true intentions and band together to stop him. Along the way, they meet a new ally in the form of Tien Shinhan, a powerful warrior from the planet Capricorn who has come to Earth to help defend it against Turles.

As the battle between Goku and Turles intensifies, the two engage in an epic fight that pushes both warriors to their limits. Meanwhile, Vegeta, who had been watching the battle from afar, becomes increasingly frustrated with his own lack of power compared to Turles' abilities.

In the end, it is revealed that Turles was actually sent to Earth by Frieza as a test to see if Goku and his friends could defeat him. With this knowledge, Goku and his friends are able to gain the upper hand in their battle against Turles, and he is ultimately defeated.

The movie ends with Goku and his friends celebrating their victory over Turles, while Vegeta finally finds the strength and confidence to join them as a powerful warrior. The Tree of Might is also shown to be destroyed, but its legacy lives on through the power of the warriors who defended it.

Overall, Dragon Ball Z: The Tree of Might is an action-packed and entertaining film that explores themes of friendship, teamwork, and the power of determination. With its epic battles and memorable characters, it remains a beloved entry in the Dragon Ball Z franchise.

overview: Cooler has resurrected himself as a robot and is enslaving the people of New Namek. Goku and the gang must help.

Dragon Ball Z: The Return of Cooler is a 1992 anime film directed by Daisuke Nishio, produced by Toei Animation. It is the third Dragon Ball Z feature film and serves as a sequel to the previous two films, Dragon Ball Z: The World's Strongest and Dragon Ball Z: The Tree of Might.

The story begins with Goku and his friends enjoying their victory over Majin Buu in the previous film. However, their celebration is short-lived as they soon discover that Cooler, the brother of Frieza, has returned to Earth seeking revenge against Goku and his friends for defeating him in the past.

Cooler, who possesses a powerful new technique called "Gravity Ball," begins to wreak havoc on the planet, using his abilities to create massive earthquakes and destroy entire cities. The Z Warriors, led by Goku, must band together once again to stop Cooler's destructive rampage.

As the battle between the Z Warriors and Cooler intensifies, it becomes clear that Cooler is not just a mindless villain, but rather a complex character with a deep-seated hatred for Goku and his friends. Throughout the film, Cooler's backstory is slowly revealed, showing how he was once a powerful warrior who was defeated by Goku in their previous encounter.

Despite being outmatched by Cooler's Gravity Ball technique, Goku and his friends refuse to give up, using their unique abilities and teamwork to try and find a way to counter Cooler's attacks. Meanwhile, Vegeta, who had previously allied himself with the Z Warriors against Frieza, begins to question his loyalty to the group, feeling that he is being held back by his own pride.

As the final battle between the Z Warriors and Cooler reaches its climax, Goku and his friends discover that Cooler's true weakness lies in his emotional vulnerability. Using this knowledge, they are able to develop a strategy to defeat Cooler once and for all.

In the end, the Z Warriors emerge victorious, having successfully defeated Cooler and saved the Earth from destruction. The film concludes with Goku and his friends reflecting on their victory, while Vegeta finally finds redemption by acknowledging his loyalty to the group.

Overall, Dragon Ball Z: The Return of Cooler is a thrilling and action-packed film that showcases the bravery and determination of the Z Warriors as they face off against one of their most formidable foes yet.

plot:
Dragon Ball Z: Bio-Broly is a 1994 Japanese animated science fiction martial arts film directed by Daisuke Nishio and produced by Toei Animation. The movie takes place during the Androids Arc of the Dragon Ball Z series.

The story begins with Goku, Trunks, and Pan traveling to the planet Vagar, where they meet a young boy named Broly, who is being raised by his mother, Paragus. However, their peaceful encounter is disrupted by the arrival of Dr. Gero's androids, led by Android 17 and Android 18.

The androids are searching for Broly, as he possesses a unique genetic makeup that makes him incredibly powerful. The androids plan to capture Broly and use his DNA to create an even more powerful being. Meanwhile, Goku and his friends soon discover that the androids' true intention is to destroy Vagar and harvest its energy.

As the story unfolds, Broly's powers grow stronger, and he becomes a formidable opponent for Goku and his friends. However, despite his incredible abilities, Broly struggles with his own identity and purpose in life. He is torn between his desire to protect those he cares about and his need to assert himself as a powerful warrior.

Throughout the movie, Goku and Broly engage in an epic battle that showcases their incredible strength and martial arts skills. Meanwhile, Trunks and Pan work together to help Paragus defeat Android 17 and Android 18.

As the conflict escalates, Broly's true nature is revealed: he is not just a powerful warrior but also a being with a deep sense of compassion and empathy. He begins to question his own existence and the purpose of his powers.

In the climactic final battle, Goku and Broly face off against each other. Despite their incredible strength, they are evenly matched, and it seems that neither can gain the upper hand. However, in a surprising twist, Broly's compassion and empathy ultimately lead him to spare Goku's life, realizing that his powers could be used for good or evil.

The movie concludes with Broly deciding to leave Vagar and find a new purpose in life, one that does not involve causing destruction and chaos. Goku and his friends bid farewell to Paragus and Broly, who sets off on a new journey, determined to use his powers for the greater good.

Overall, Dragon Ball Z: Bio-Broly is an action-packed and emotionally resonant film that explores themes of identity, compassion, and the responsible use of power. The movie features stunning animation, memorable characters, and epic battles that will keep fans of the Dragon Ball Z series on the edge of their seats.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Fusion Reborn

tagline: Hell’s gates have opened.
overview: Not paying attention to his job, a young demon allows the evil cleansing machine to overflow and explode, turning the young demon into the infamous monster Janemba. Goku and Vegeta make solo attempts to defeat the monster, but realize their only option is fusion.
plot:
In the other world, a teenage oni is manning a cleansing machine and the loud volume of his walkman distracts him, causing the machine to explode. The oni is engulfed by the freed evil spirit essence and transforms into Janemba, a massive childlike monster with dimensional manipulation abilities. As a result, the deceased are resurrected.
Goku and Pikkon are fighting in a tournament when they are interrupted by the appearance of a strange crystal-like substance and are sent to investigate the disturbance by the Grand Kai. They find the afterlife's "check-in station" to be encased in the crystal-like barrier which is also immune to their energy blasts. From inside of the station, its trapped attendant King Yemma directs them to the monster, Janemba, who refuses to drop the barrier. Goku lures Janemba to hell while Pikkon works to free Yemma.
Meanwhile, Earth comes under siege by an array of zombies, soldiers and past villains led by Frieza, who attack a city until Gohan and Videl intervene, with the former destroying him causing the villains to flee in terror. The two along with Bulma, Goten and Trunks gather the magical Dragon Balls and summon the dragon Shenron to ask him to rebuild the barrier between the living and dead, but he is unable to do so since only Yemma can control the boundaries of the afterlife. Forcing them to continue the fight against those who escaped hell. Goten and Trunks faced a Dictator with alongside his army, he appeared to be a parody of Adolf Hitler truly showing the horrors being released. In hell, Janemba uses his unorthodox powers to best Goku until he powers up to Super Saiyan 3, shaking Other World while he does it, and seemingly kills Janemba. He merely transforms into a much smaller, albeit far more powerful and sinister form - Super Janemba. Goku is overwhelmed by Super Janemba but Vegeta has regained his physical body and arrives in time to help. However, the two Saiyans are still no match for Super Janemba and are forced to hide. Goku proposes using the Fusion Dance technique, but Vegeta pridefully refuses to join bodies with Goku.
Pikkon continues to try and free Yemma to no avail, and in his anger, insults the crystal substance which causes it to slightly crack. However, Pikkon's worst insults do not cause enough damage to rescue Yemma so he decides to aid Goku and Vegeta in their fight. After much persuasion, Vegeta agrees to fuse with Goku but Vegeta fails to extend his forefinger when required and the fusion fails, resulting in a weak, obese form named Veku. Super Janemba beats Veku severely and almost kills him, but the fusion wears off and Goku and Vegeta escape in time. Pikkon arrives to stall Super Janemba while Goku and Vegeta attempt the fusion again, this time successfully transforming into the immensely powerful Super Gogeta, who swiftly gains the advantage over Janemba and he uses his power to defeat the demon, causing him to revert into his oni form, who flees.

plot:
Dragon Ball Z: Wrath of the Dragon is a 1995 Japanese animated science fantasy martial arts film produced by Toei Animation, based on the Dragon Ball Z manga series created by Akira Toriyama. The movie takes place after the events of the Androids Arc in the Dragon Ball Z anime series.

The story begins with a mysterious and powerful being known as Janemba, who is said to be the reincarnation of the demon king Piccolo Jr.'s evil spirit. Janemba is awakened from his slumber by the evil wizard Babidi, who seeks to use him to destroy Goku and take over the Earth.

Babidi's plan involves using a magical ritual to merge with Janemba's body, creating an even more powerful being known as Majin Buu. However, the ritual goes awry, and instead of merging with Janemba, Babidi is consumed by his own evil energy.

Meanwhile, Goku and his friends are unaware of the impending threat and continue their daily lives. However, when a series of mysterious events occur, they begin to suspect that something is amiss. They soon discover that Janemba has been awakened and is wreaking havoc on the Earth.

As the story unfolds, Goku and his allies, including Trunks, Goten, and Piccolo, band together to stop Janemba and Babidi. Along the way, they encounter a number of powerful foes, including the evil wizard's minions and a group of powerful warriors known as the "Warriors of Destruction."

The final battle takes place in the city of Capsule Corp., where Goku and his friends face off against Janemba and Babidi. In the end, Goku is able to defeat Janemba using the Spirit Bomb technique, while Trunks and Goten work together to defeat Babidi.

Throughout the movie, there are several themes that are explored, including the nature of evil and the power of friendship and teamwork. The film also features a number of action-packed sequences, showcasing the martial arts skills of the Dragon Ball Z characters.

Overall, Dragon Ball Z: Wrath of the Dragon is an exciting and entertaining addition to the Dragon Ball Z franchise, offering fans a thrilling adventure filled with intense battles and memorable moments.

title: Detective Conan: Crossroad in the Ancient Capital
original_title: 名探偵コナン 迷宮の十字路
overview: Mouri Kogoro is called to a special case in the ancient capital of Kyoto. There, Conan meets Heiji and they team up once again to solve the case, recover the stolen Healing Buddha statue, and even discover the identity of Heiji's first love.
plot:
A series of murders occurs across Tokyo, Osaka, and Kyoto, in which five men are killed using traditional Japanese weapons such as sword and bow and arrow. The perpetrator is described as wearing a Noh mask depicting an elderly man. Investigations conducted jointly by the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department, Osaka Prefectural Police, and Kyoto Prefectural Police reveal that the victims were all members of Genji Hotaru, a criminal group specializing in the theft of antique art. The remaining known members of the group are its leader, known as Yoshitsune, his subordinate Benkei, and Ise Saburo, though their true identities remain unknown.
Around the same time, Kogoro Mouri travels to Kyoto with Conan Edogawa and the others at the request of Ryuen, a monk from Sannoji Temple. Eight years earlier, a secret Buddhist statue—the Medicine Buddha, which is revealed only once every twelve years—was stolen from the temple. Recently, the temple received a mysterious drawing believed to indicate the statue's location, and Kogoro is asked to decipher it. At Sannoji Temple, the group meets several individuals connected to the case, including the monk Enkai, antique art dealer and temple patron Sakura Shozo, Noh actor Mizuo Harutaro, and used bookstore owner Taiga Saijo.
While searching for clues related to the drawing, Conan visits Gojo Bridge, a location historically associated with Minamoto no Yoshitsune and Musashibo Benkei, where he encounters Heiji Hattori. Heiji is independently investigating the Genji Hotaru murders, and the two decide to cooperate. During the investigation, Heiji recounts his first love: a girl he met in Kyoto eight years earlier, who was wearing a kimono and singing a temari uta (traditional Japanese ballad) at a temple. He also mentions a crystal ball he picked up at that time, which he continues to carry as a keepsake.
Conan and Heiji later travel to Mount Kurama, where they are attacked by an unknown assailant wielding a bow and arrow and wearing a motorcycle suit. That night, Sakura Shozo is murdered at a teahouse in Ponto-chō. Shortly afterward, Heiji is attacked again while escorting Kazuha Toyama home. The assailant challenges him to a duel using wooden swords, and Heiji is severely injured and hospitalized. Conan eventually deciphers the code in the drawing and determines that the Medicine Buddha statue is hidden at Bukkoji Temple. When Heiji arrives there, he receives a phone call from the culprit, who reveals that Kazuha has been kidnapped and orders Heiji to come to Gyokuryu Temple on Mount Kurama.
At Gyokuryu Temple, "Heiji" confronts the criminal and identifies him as Saijo, who is revealed to be Benkei. Saijo orders his disciples to attack, but "Heiji" intervenes, later revealed to be Conan, who temporarily regresses back into Shinichi Kudo by the cold will and alcohol with the help of Ai Haibara, in disguise. The real Heiji soon joins the confrontation, allowing Kazuha to escape with him into a room within the temple.

title: Detective Conan: Strategy Above the Depths
original_title: 名探偵コナン 水平線上の陰謀
overview: Fifteen years ago in a barren stretch of the Pacific, a cruise ship collided with an iceberg and was lost at sea. More than a decade later, Hideto Yashiro—a ship engineer—died in a fatal car accident. The unlikely connection between these events only comes to light on the luxury liner St. Aphrodite during her maiden voyage. Aboard it on a much needed vacation, Kogorou Mouri, his daughter Ran, Conan Edogawa, and the Detective Boys enjoy a trip provided by Sonoko Suzuki's family. But their fun is soon cut short when a game of hide-and-seek leads to Sonoko's disappearance.
plot:
Fifteen years ago, a cargo ship named Yashiromaru, built by the Yashiro group, sank while colliding with iceberg. Fifteen years later on a new on a 100 million yen luxurious cruise ship named the MS Aphrodite, also built by the Yashiro group, Conan Edogawa and the rest were invited to the cruise through Sonoko Suzuki. Earlier, the husband of the CEO of the Yashiro family group, an established ship architect, apparently had a heart-attack and drove his car down a cliff.
On Aphrodite, the CEO herself was found murdered in her room. Later, her father, the president of the Yashiro group was also found missing. He had been thrown off the cruise into the ocean, seemingly by the same person. At the welcoming party, Kogoro Mouri shows off his deduction skills, and concluded that the sub-designer of the cruise, Minako Akiyoshi, was the murderer.
However, Conan has different ideas. Hironari Kusaka, a scriptwriter who worked in co-operation with Akiyoshi on a script, was the culprit. Kusaka reveals to Aphrodite captain Wataru Kaido that the accident from 15 years ago was a scheme to sink Yashiromaru deliberately to get insurance. His father was murdered when he discovered the captain of the ship was drugged by Kaido when he was a vice captain and left to die. Kusaka immediately set off bombs and escaped by sea and the Detective Boys gave chase.
After they, Juzo Megure, Ninzaburou Shiratori and Wataru Takagi of Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department successfully took down Kusaka, more bombs were ignited. All passengers were evacuated, but Ran returned to her hiding place during the hide-and-seek game to find a "gold medal" made by sea-shells the Detective Boys made for her. However, as Aphrodite swayed, she fainted in the enclosed area. Just before Kaido evacuates, Akiyoshi takes him hostage, turning out she was the real murderer after all, and was the one who did all three killings and made Kusaka think that he did them himself.
Akiyoshi also revealed that her father was the captain who died while Yashiromaru sank. Kogoro, however, deduced correctly this time and managed to subdue Akiyoshi. He was originally trying to find evidence to prove her innocence because of her strong resemblance to his wife Eri Kisaki, but the more investigation he does, the more guilty she became. As Kogoro and Conan began to evacuate, they found out that Ran was missing. They find her under the deck of the boat with the help of a fire axe. Afterwards, a helicopter of Japan Coast Guard comes and picks them up, just before Aphrodite sinks stern-first to the bottom of the ocean.
In the post-credits scene, Conan explained he knew where Ran was because when he kicked the volleyball, Ran said she heard a soccer ball, meaning she was in a place with a tough wall. The Detective Boys come, and told Ran they made a better "gold medal" for her, and put it on her.

title: Detective Conan: The Private Eyes' Requiem

overview: Synopsis Kogoro and Conan came to Yokohama according to a request from a mysterious man. But that was a trap of this man. Ran and the Detective Boys will be taken as hostages. If they don't solve the request of the man within 12 hours, the bombs attached to the hostages will explode. Furthermore, the man know that Conan`s true identity is Kudo Shinichi. Also Hattori Heiji, the High School Detective of the West, and Kaito Kid enter the stage. Will they be able to solve the mystery within the time limit and save Ran and the others? And who in the world is the client?
plot:
In Yokohama, Conan Edogawa, Kogoro, Ran Mouri, Ayumi Yoshida, Genta Kojima, Mitsuhiko Tsuburaya and Ai Haibara are invited to visit a mysterious client in a hotel named Red Castle beside a theme park called Miracle Land. Ran and the kids leave after being given free theme park wristbands, while Conan and Kogoro are forced by the client to solve a mystery to remove the wristbands, which are set to detonate. The client also reveals that the wristbands given to Ran and company are set to detonate should they leave the premises. The client reveals that two other detectives gave up, one named Ryu killed, while one is still working.
Conan and Kogoro investigate an abandoned hotel where they find ski masks and a gun, which were used for a robbery. On the same date of the robbery, the Kaito Kid stole some jewels from a nearby company. Kogoro retrieves the bag, but ends up getting arrested as Kid's accomplice. During the questioning, the client calls Conan, correctly identifies him as Shinichi Kudo and gives him a second clue. Conan meets Heiji Hattori who reveals that he is also part of the search, with his friend Kazuha Toyama also held captive.
Heiji and Conan work together and end up in Yokohama Oceanic University where they join together with Saguru Hakuba, a famous British-Japanese detective. They find out that one of the former presidents of the club, Nishio Masaharu, was charged with the murder of a classmate. Heiji then confirms with the client through the phone that the mystery he wants them to solve was the murder case. They are attacked by two motorcyclists working for Souichiro Miyama, the art museum owner who is trying to kill Kid. To escape, the three detectives split up, while Conan ends up falling from a bridge and breaks his leg. Meanwhile at Miracle Land, the mugger attempts to take Ayumi hostage when they reaches the entrance, but was backfired by Sonoko Suzuki and Miwako Sato, who was go on a date with Wataru Takagi at the park.
Kogoro is already giving his report to the client in Red Castle when Heiji knocks him out so he does not get killed for giving a wrong conclusion. They then discover the client, later confirmed as Suehiko Ito, who is a blind wheelchair user and reveal the truth to him. Ito, Nishio and Reiko Shimizu, a woman who Ito was in love with, were staging the robbery of an armored truck. The robbery went wrong when a guard was killed and the robbers' escape was then witnessed by Kid. Thus, Nishio was murdered in order to keep the involvement of the other two silent. Conan and Heiji reveal that Nishio was already dead before Ito shot him and that Reiko was the true killer. When Ito panicked and tried to leave the city, his car was sabotaged in an attempt to kill him. Reiko appears at that moment and confirms the truth behind the incident. She attempts to kill the detectives but is knocked out.

overview: Serial murders involving all kinds have happened. All the victims are from a Music School led by a famous pianist. Conan and company have been invited to a opening concert of the Music Hall built by the pianist. The biggest attraction of this concert is the world famous violin called "Stradivarius" and a special appearance of a singer who has perfect pitch.
plot:
At Domoto Music Academy, a violinist named Soko Wakabe is observing two students during a practice while she sends a message on her cellphone and the explosion occurs, injuring Wakabe and killing students. Elsewhere, an unknown person reads the news on the computer and comments on how he is getting closer to his plan of a "Silent Night."
Later, on the grounds outside the academy, Conan Edogawa talks to Ran Mouri on the phone as Shinichi Kudo. He investigates and sees an old man who is the former piano tuner turned director of the Domoto Concert Hall named Takumi Fuwa carefully picking up a piano key from the piano destroyed in the explosion and putting it in his pocket before leaves in a car. Ran invites him to go to a rehearsal with her at the concert hall that is opening soon. He declines and tells her she's meddling too much which causes her to angrily reply that he will never be like Sherlock Holmes because he's tone deaf and Ran angrily hangs up.
At the rehearsal; Kogoro, Ran, Sonoko Suzuki, and the Detective Boys are introduced to the person who will be performing for the Domoto Concert Hall opening; the organist and former pianist Kazuki Domoto, Fuwa, German professional organ tuner Hans Müller, son of Kazuki and pianist Genya, soprano Rara Chigusa, violinist Shion Yuhane, and the main soprano Reiko Akiba. The Detective Boys help Akiba to help their class choir to sing their school anthem. She agreed but asked them to leave immediately, possibly to allow Shion, who is shy, to perform without fear.
The next day, Ran plays the piano while the kids sing the Teitan Elementary School anthem. Akiba comments on their performance; Genta Kojima is too loud, Mitsuhiko Tsuburaya is not putting enough feelings into it as he was staring at Ai Haibara, Ai is singing like an adult, Ayumi Yoshida is perfect, and Conan is off-key the whole time. He is revealed later to have a perfect pitch. Genta steals a drink of Akiba's tea and suffers in agonizing pain. At the hospital, the doctor says that Genta's throat is severely inflamed by chemicals, and he will not be able to speak for about four days. The Detective Boys, Sonoko, and Akiba accompany Genta home. On the way home, they are chased by a truck, so at one of the turns, Akiba takes a different route to get the truck away from them. She trips and is about to be run over until a taxi comes and the car turns, only for the culprit to escape.
Later, two more murders occur. One explosion kills Osamu Shida, with the foot joint of a flute left on the scene. The other murder occurs when the paraglider of the victim is cut with fine cuts to cause it to plunge from mid-air. In the victim's car is the headjoint of the flute. These 2 victims, together with the 2 dead victims from the earlier explosion, formerly belonged to a group called the Quarter Quintet. Conan, indebted to Akiba for a reason he has forgotten, follows her to the forest as she is known to relax there on the day before the concert.

title: When in Rome
overview: Teenage sisters Charli and Lola are on the verge of an experience beyond their wildest dreams! Pack your bags and jet off to Rome as the girls start their summer internship working for the legendary Derek Hanson - the totally cool international tycoon whose empire reaches from airlines to cutting-edge fashion. Amid the fabulous sights of this exciting city, the girls do their best to impress their boss, while still finding time to design their own line of very hip clothing, meet some very cute guys and turn their summer abroad into one awesome adventure they - and you - will never forget!
plot:
When in Rome is a 2002 American adventure comedy directed by Steve Purcell and starring Mary-Kate and Ashley Olsen. Produced by the twins' company Dualstar Entertainment Group together with Tapestry Films, it skipped theaters and was released directly to home video by Warner Home Video on November 26, 2002. The supporting cast includes Leslie Danon, Julian Stone and Michelangelo Tommaso.

The Olsens play Leila and Charli Hunter, sisters who travel to Rome to take part in a summer internship program at a fashion company. They are joined by four other young interns from around the world, Paolo, Nobu, Dari and Heidi. Shortly after the program begins, a series of careless accidents gets the sisters dismissed, but their luck turns when they cross paths with the wealthy businessman Derek Hammond, who gives them their positions back. While spending a day at Hammond's home, Leila meets his rebellious nephew Ryan, and the two are quickly drawn to one another, while Charli begins to fall for her fellow intern Paolo.

Back at the office the girls start to take their responsibilities more seriously and form close friendships with the rest of the intern group. Their newfound commitment is tested when the scheming Mr. Tortoni, the head of the company, sabotages an important delivery by making off with the dresses intended for a photo shoot. With Ryan's assistance, Leila manages to photograph the theft and brings the evidence to Derek. The interns then rally together to produce a replacement collection from Charli's own designs, finishing just in time for the big day. The shoot is a success and Tortoni is forced to take the interns back. When Derek arrives, it emerges that Tortoni's actions were driven by long-standing jealousy over Derek's fortune and his romance with a woman named Jamie.

Like many of the Olsen twins' projects of the period, When in Rome combines a picturesque European setting with light romance and a message about friendship, teamwork and taking responsibility, and it was aimed squarely at the pair's large preteen audience. It was one of a string of international-setting adventures the sisters made for the direct-to-video market in the early 2000s, alongside titles set in other foreign cities, before they moved on to the theatrical comedy New York Minute in 2004.

title: Real Steel
tagline: If you get one shot, make it real.
overview: Charlie Kenton is a washed-up fighter who retired from the ring when robots took over the sport. After his robot is trashed, he reluctantly teams up with his estranged son to rebuild and train an unlikely contender.
plot:
Real Steel is a 2011 American science fiction sports film produced and directed by Shawn Levy, based on Richard Matheson's 1956 short story "Steel," which had earlier been adapted as an episode of The Twilight Zone. Hugh Jackman stars as Charlie Kenton, a washed-up former boxer, with Dakota Goyo as his son, Max, Evangeline Lilly as Bailey Tallet, Anthony Mackie and Kevin Durand. The film was released by Touchstone Pictures in October 2011, with Steven Spielberg among its executive producers.

In the 2020s, human boxing has been replaced by fights between giant robots. Charlie, a former contender who scrapes a living fighting robots in small venues, loses his machine, Ambush, in a bout against a bull at a Texas carnival run by Ricky, and flees without paying the bet he lost. He then learns that his former girlfriend has died and that he must attend a custody hearing for their eleven-year-old son, Max, whom he has never known. Max's wealthy aunt, Debra, and her husband, Marvin, want custody, and Charlie agrees to give it up in exchange for money, on the condition that he takes care of Max for the summer while the couple travels.

Using the money, Charlie buys Noisy Boy, a once-famous robot from the World Robot Boxing league, but it is destroyed in an underground arena. While scavenging for parts in a junkyard, Max finds Atom, an old sparring robot that saves him from a fall. Atom is built to withstand punishment and has a rare "shadow" function that allows it to mimic human movements. Max insists on fighting with Atom, and Charlie, drawing on his boxing experience, teaches the robot to fight. The underdog robot wins a series of bouts and becomes a crowd favorite, earning a chance to face Zeus, the undefeated champion of the World Robot Boxing league. Along the way, Charlie grows closer to Max and Bailey and begins to rediscover the man he once was, and he must decide whether to give up his son.

Real Steel received generally positive reviews, with critics praising its visual effects, Jackman's and Goyo's performances and its crowd-pleasing spirit, though some found it formulaic. It grossed about $300 million worldwide and was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Visual Effects.
